run_tcp_connect: run the tcp_connect script to open a TCP handshake to a specified server host and port
run_tcp_connect_timeout: run the tcp_connect script with a custom timeout to force process exit after N seconds
test_tcp_connect: test the tcp_connect module by connecting to a server host on a given port with a timeout
review_main: review the main function that parses server host, port, and timeout arguments for TCP connection
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional socket options or connection retry logic
